chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah al-Hashimi, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah al-Hashimi.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate source named by the author.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial reporting of the chain.
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: An intermediary narrator in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ الْهَاشِم: A narrator whose transmission path is being clarified here.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي ال: A narrator in the chain of transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah al-Hashimi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah al-Hashimi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission through which the author received these hadith.
